name: Advanced Algorithms Roadmap
description: For engineers targeting top-tier interviews or competitions. Covers advanced DP, graph algorithms, and hard problem patterns.
milestones: Advanced dynamic programming — knapsack, LIS, interval DP.
Graph algorithms — topological sort, union-find, MST, shortest paths.
Segment trees and Fenwick trees for range queries.
Hard two-pointer, sliding window, and monotonic stack problems.
study_plan: Week 3: advanced graphs — MST, union-find, Dijkstra variants.
Week 4: trees/tries and range-query data structures.
Week 5-6: hard mixed problems and timed contests.
tips: Master a few advanced data structures deeply before broadening.
Re-implement each algorithm from memory to build muscle memory.
